# THE OWED LEDGER of the name-buildability nightly (tools/namebuild/owed.go).
# One line per (leg, row) that does not build yet, with its true cause:
#   <leg> <row> owed: <cause>
# An exact set: a failure not listed here fails the nightly, and a listed job
# that builds fails it too (stale), so each line goes when its fix lands.
# Found by the generator-internal-name sweep (#4947).

# C: the C backend's own refusal is not lifted to the checker
c n_internal_52 owed: enum placed beside enum placed_t: the C backend qualifies both to probe_placed_t and refuses at generate; schema check accepts the pair

# C#: a contextual keyword the reserved-word table lacks
cs n_internal_75 owed: enum unmanaged: the generic constraint `where T : unmanaged` resolves to the enum, CS0701; schema check does not reserve unmanaged for C#

# Dart packet: a union tag is an extension type over int, and an arm's static const may not share an int/num member's name
dart n_internal_11 owed: union arm bitLength: the tag type NameArms3Type implements int, and static bitLength clashes with int.bitLength
dart n_internal_15 owed: union arm clamp: the tag type implements int, and static clamp clashes with num.clamp
dart n_internal_29 owed: union arm floor: the tag type implements int, and static floor clashes with int.floor
dart n_internal_34 owed: union arms isFinite, isNaN, isNegative: the tag type implements int, and the statics clash with num's members
dart n_internal_61 owed: union arm remainder: the tag type implements int, and static remainder clashes with num.remainder
dart n_internal_67 owed: union arm sign: the tag type implements int, and static sign clashes with int.sign
dart n_internal_73 owed: union arm truncate: the tag type implements int, and static truncate clashes with int.truncate
# Dart: derived names of two declarations collide
dart n_internal_19 owed: enums days and daysFrom: the text form declares daysFromName for days (<e>FromName) and for daysFrom (<e>Name); schema check does not see derived names
dart n_internal_43 owed: enums mismatch and mismatchFrom: the text form declares mismatchFromName for both (<e>FromName, <e>Name); schema check does not see derived names
dart n_internal_41 owed: enum main: a Dart library may declare main only as a function, so the entry point's library fails to compile; schema check does not refuse main for Dart

# Lobster: a builtin the reserved-word table lacks
